stemMd: What is the coefficient of $x^2$ in $(2x-1)(x^2+3x+4)$?
explanationMd: The x-squared terms come from 2x times 3x and −1 times x squared, giving 6x squared−x squared=5x squared.

distractorRationale.c: This adds rather than subtracts the second contribution.
distractorRationale.d: This is the contribution 2x times 4 to the linear term.
distractorRationale.b: This counts 2x times 3x but omits negative one times x squared.
